# Street Culture Tattoo & Academy

> Custom tattoo studio, professional piercing studio and tattoo artist academy in Kandivali West, Mumbai. 4.8★ on Google. Resident artists Karan Parmar (fine line, lettering, black & grey) and Lucky Solanki (colour, realism, 16+ years experience). INK IS CULTURE.

## Services

- Custom tattoos (colour, black & grey, fine line, realism, cover-ups)
- Professional piercings
- Tattoo artist academy / training courses (diploma and foundation level)
- Tattoo portfolio and healed-work gallery at /gallery

## Academy

- "Twin Diploma in Tattooing" — 5 months, all levels, taught by Lucky Solanki, assisted by Karan Parmar
- Foundation training covering design fundamentals, machine handling, hygiene and portfolio building
- Course details: https://www.streetculturetattoos.com/academy
